_como_editar: Textos en INGLES para en/index.html. Los HECHOS (nombres, fechas, LinkedIn, ranking, cifras) NO van aca: la pagina los lee de club.json, eventos.json y torneo-portada.json, asi que se actualizan solos. Aca va solo lo que hay que traducir. Al crear un evento nuevo en eventos.json, agregarle su entrada en `eventos` con la misma clave (el id); si falta, la pagina en ingles simplemente no lo muestra en vez de mostrarlo en espanol.

torneo-portafolio-2026.resumen: 54 teams run simulated USD 10 million portfolios in iShares/BlackRock ETFs, measured against the MSCI ACWI on Bloomberg metrics. Rankings publish every Friday, and the final is judged on November 9.

clase-edv-2026.resumen: Financial education for secondary-school students: an introduction to investing, market analysis and portfolio construction, with hands-on exercises in the Bloomberg Lab.

visita-santander-2026.resumen: Corporate visit to Banco Santander Chile, with a session on money market fund management, treasury operations and the investment team's own experience.

visita-moneda-2026.resumen: Institutional visit to Moneda Patria Investments, one of Latin America's most significant asset managers. A first-hand look at how a fund manager works and how investment decisions actually get made.

fiw-mayo-2026.resumen: A gathering of FEN Investment Woman, the initiative driving women's participation in investing and financial markets: a network for collaboration, mentoring and professional development.

charla-analisis-tecnico-2025.resumen: A masterclass on technical market analysis: reading charts, identifying patterns and trends, managing risk and trading in the short run.

torneo-primavera-2025.resumen: The first edition of the FIG Portfolio Tournament: a full competition with simulated portfolio management, team presentations and an awards ceremony.

charla-colegios-lab-2025.resumen: An introduction to financial markets for secondary-school students, held in the Bloomberg Lab with hands-on demonstrations of real investment tools.

lanzamiento-club-2025.resumen: The official launch of FEN Investment Group to the faculty community, with the founders, strategic partners and prospective members.
